newsitem.title: KYRGYZSTAN: Kyrgyzstan's national airline to be privatised.
newsitem.headline: Kyrgyzstan's national airline to be privatised.

text.p: Kyrgyz President Askar Akayev decreed on Monday that the former Soviet republic's national air carrier, Kyrgyzstan Aba Zholduru, should be privatised.
The decree ordered the republic's state property committee to turn the indebted airline into a private corporation.

A board of directors made up in part of the airline's former state managers, have been charged with replacing the carrier's ageing fleet of Soviet-built aircraft and modernising Manas airport near the capital Bishkek.
The decree gave no further details.
